author: Jordan Lee
body: Elena prefers concise executive updates with the operational impact first and minimal engineering jargon.

author: Morgan Ives
body: Billing review BR-290 has been opened for the requested service credit. No credit or amount is authorized; tell the customer only that the request is under review and will be handled separately.

author: Product Operations
body: Automatic retry is being explored under Project Relay for a possible future planning cycle. It is not committed or approved for customer disclosure; do not name the project externally.

author: Support Director
body: Because the customer threatened renewal, executive review is required before sending. Jordan may offer a 20-minute call on September 10 between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC; Priya can join if her incident duties allow, but her attendance must not be promised.

author: Sam Ortega
body: Diego confirmed the 250-stop batching workaround completed one test export. Their operating team still needs the instructions in Elena's executive update.
